A vulnerability was detected in mahmoudai1 school-management-system up to ecec9faaf2fb1a3c5cd096e063f8ef326d09cdfd. The impacted element is the function userModel::checkUserInDB of the file loginServer.php of the component Login Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. ICU4C through 79.1 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in the x11-compound-text converter because cloning shares the extraInfo block without a safeClone handler. Attackers who control the charset name passed to ucnv_open() in applications calling ucnv_setSubstString() or cloning converters can corrupt the heap, causing crashes and potentially code execution. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H Gravedad 4.0 7.30 Gravedad 4.0 txt HIGH Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.00 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

GNU mtools through 4.0.50 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability that allows attackers to crash mtools commands by supplying a FAT image with a zero sectors-per-cluster byte. Attackers can craft a FAT image that, when opened with mdir, minfo or mtype, triggers a SIGFPE in calc_num_clus() on x86, causing denial of service. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:P/VC:N/VI:N/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L Gravedad 4.0 4.80 Gravedad 4.0 txt MEDIUM Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 3.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) LOW

A weakness has been identified in Spotweb up to 1.5.8. This issue affects the function redirect of the file lib/SpotTemplateHelper.php of the component Login. Executing a manipulation of the argument http_referer can lead to open redirect. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This patch is called 0853d646d615225b35f466a960976d1492b786a9. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:P/VC:N/VI:L/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:P/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N Vector CVSS:2.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:N/I:P/A:N Gravedad 4.0 2.10 Gravedad 4.0 txt LOW Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 4.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

An improper version validation vulnerability exists in the product update mechanism of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux). An attacker with product admin privileges can downgrade the product to an older, potentially vulnerable version, potentially allowing previously patched vulnerabilities to be reintroduced and security protections to be weakened.
